blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do not wear the patch for more than 8 hours. If you experience skin irritation or develop a rash discontinue use immediately. If skin irritation continues or worsens, consult a healthcare professional immediately.
If you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications or have any medical condition, consult your doctor before use. Keep out of reach of children.
